notes: compress::bzip2: Streaming Reader with multi-stream, block/stream CRCs and Go's Huffman/StructuralError semantics; opt-in output and block-size Limits (unlimited output by default); truncation delivers Go's zero-filled partial output, checked against Go; decompression only, as in Go

NewReader.note: on truncated input the reader keeps decoding zero bits as Go does and delivers the same bytes Go returns with io.ErrUnexpectedEOF; a Rust Read cannot return bytes and an error together, so the error follows on the next read

StructuralError.Error.note: the Display impl of StructuralError gives the same 'bzip2 data invalid: ' message; checked by tools/bzip2_check.py
